meta.notes: Weights in Stein (1 Stein = 1 kg). Prices in Silbertaler. Source AA (Aventuria Armory) excluded — TDE5 system. secondary_talents: weapon can be used with these talents in addition to combat_talent.

pdf_sources_for_range_bands: tde_german_rules (DSA 4.1 Basisregelwerk): Aventurische Schuss- und Wurfwaffen p.163; Entfernung/Reichweiteklassen p.152-155.
ranged_and_throwing.distance_class_span: distance_class_min / distance_class_max: inclusive Entfernungsklassen (EK) span from BRW combat grid.
ranged_and_throwing.range_bands_schritt_upper_note: range_bands_schritt_upper: five upper inclusive limits in Schritt, matching reichweiteklassen_order. BRW p.153.
ranged_and_throwing.tp_plus_by_range_band_note: tp_plus_by_range_band: optional TP shifts. null = em-dash in BRW table (not applicable).

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.special: Universal sidearm. Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds. Can be thrown (improvised throw).
weapons.notes: Most common sidearm in Aventuria. Straight double-edged blade about one span long.

weapons.name: Dragon Tooth
weapons.special: Broad, sturdy dwarven dagger. Non-dwarves suffer -1 AT, PA, DP. Cannot parry chain, two-handed blunt, or two-handed sword attacks.
weapons.notes: Dwarf-crafted. No known human-sized version.

weapons.name: Hunting Knife
weapons.special: One-sided blade; poor parrying weapon. Can be thrown (improvised).
weapons.notes: Standard tool knife in many regions.

weapons.name: Parrying Dagger
weapons.special: Designed for off-hand parrying. Counts as a parrying weapon (Sondereigenschaft: Parierdolch). Cannot parry chain or two-handed blunt attacks.
weapons.notes: Broad blade with side-prongs for trapping opponent's blade.

weapons.name: Stiletto
weapons.special: Very thin needle-like blade; excellent AT but very poor PA. Cannot parry.
weapons.notes: Designed for thrusting between armor gaps.

weapons.name: Hatchet
weapons.special: Can be thrown (throwing hatchet). If thrown counts as throwing weapon.
weapons.notes: Light one-handed axe.

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.special: Standard one-handed battle axe.
weapons.notes: Common among warriors and mercenaries.

weapons.name: Club
weapons.special: Blunt Blow at only -2 AT penalty (not -4). Can be used to knock unconscious.
weapons.notes: Simple wooden cudgel. Stun Blow penalty is -2.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.special: Armor-crushing weapon. Ignores 2 RS when KO/2 threshold is met. Blunt Blow at -4 AT.
weapons.notes: Flanged or spiked head. Popular with clergy who shun edged weapons.

weapons.name: War Hammer
weapons.special: Heavy blunt weapon. On wound: target loses 1 additional AT/PA until end of next round. Blunt Blow at -4.
weapons.notes: Large hammerhead on a short haft.

weapons.name: Cutlass
weapons.special: Short heavy blade for close quarters. Favored by pirates and sailors.
weapons.notes: Also called 'boarding saber'. Single-edged, slightly curved.

weapons.name: Saber
weapons.special: Versatile slashing weapon. Can be used mounted.
weapons.notes: Single-edged curved blade. Standard cavalry weapon.

weapons.name: Shamshir
weapons.special: Fast, slightly curved slashing blade. AT bonus due to light, thin blade.
weapons.notes: Sharper curve than standard saber. Common among Novadis.

weapons.name: Heavy Saber
weapons.special: Heavier variant; more damage, slightly reduced PA and INI.
weapons.notes: Between cavalry saber and scimitar in weight.

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.special: One-handed sword suitable for all combat distances except very long reach weapons.
weapons.notes: Broad double-edged blade roughly one and a half spans long.

weapons.name: Long Sword
weapons.special: Standard military sword. Balanced for AT and PA.
weapons.notes: The classic knight's weapon. About two and a half spans long.

weapons.name: Thorwal Sword
weapons.special: Broad, heavy blade used both as an axe (chopping) and a sword. +1 DP vs. armor (BRW: RS effective -1 against it).
weapons.notes: The traditional weapon of Thorwaler warriors.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword
weapons.special: Can be wielded one- or two-handed. When two-handed: +1 DP. No shield may be carried. Blows from chain weapons cannot be parried.
weapons.notes: The 'royal discipline' of blade weapons. Switching grips is a free action.

weapons.name: Tuzak Knife
weapons.special: A massive chopper used by Tuzak. Treated as a bastard sword for talent purposes.
weapons.notes: Blade is as long as a human forearm plus hand.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.special: Thrusting weapon. Cannot parry chain weapon or two-handed blunt weapon attacks. High AT and PA bonus.
weapons.notes: Narrow flexible blade, basket hilt. The weapon of duelists.

weapons.name: Foil
weapons.special: Very light thrusting weapon. Excellent AT modifier. Cannot parry chain, two-handed blunt, or two-handed sword attacks.
weapons.notes: Training and dueling weapon. Very thin blade.

weapons.name: Épée
weapons.special: Balanced thrusting sword. Cannot parry chain or two-handed blunt.
weapons.notes: Between rapier and foil. Used across noble courts.

weapons.name: Short Spear
weapons.special: One-handed spear. Can be thrown. Gains +2 AT against mounted foes.
weapons.notes: Common hunting and militia weapon.

weapons.name: Long Spear
weapons.special: Two-handed. Cannot be combined with shield. +4 AT vs. mounted when braced. Counts as a pole weapon for distance classes.
weapons.notes: Standard infantry spear. Used in shield walls.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.special: Three-pronged spear. On successful AT, opponent must roll to avoid being disarmed (STR vs. AT score). Can catch weapon on critical PA.
weapons.notes: Gladiatorial and fishing weapon.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.special: Two-handed. Excellent PA bonus. Blunt weapon — can deal stun (Blunt Blow at -2 AT). Hardened wood or metal-banded.
weapons.notes: The classic wizard's and traveler's weapon.

weapons.name: Two-Lily Staff
weapons.special: Balanced fighting staff with metal lily-head ends. Better AT than quarterstaff.
weapons.notes: Traditional weapon of some warrior guilds.

weapons.name: Two-Handed Sword
weapons.special: Two-handed. Cannot be combined with shield. Requires at least 15 ST to wield effectively (else -2 AT, PA).
weapons.notes: Massive blade. The Zweihänder of Aventuria.

weapons.name: Elf Sword
weapons.special: Elven-crafted. Light for its size. Can be wielded one-handed by elves only (then uses Swords talent). Non-elves must use two-handed swords talent.
weapons.notes: Exquisitely balanced. Rare outside elven settlements.

weapons.name: Great Axe
weapons.special: Two-handed. Very high damage. Attacks from this weapon cannot be parried with daggers or fencing weapons. Requires ST 15+.
weapons.notes: Massive chopping axe. Not for the faint-hearted.

weapons.name: Two-Handed Hammer
weapons.special: Two-handed. Enormous impact force. On wound: knockback (STR check or fall). Blunt Blow at -8 AT.
weapons.notes: Dwarven-style war hammer. Devastating.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.special: Two-handed pole weapon. +2 AT vs. mounted opponents. Counts as pole weapon for distance classes.
weapons.notes: Long haft with a single-edged blade.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.special: Two-handed. Axe blade + spear tip + hook. Cannot be parried by daggers or fencing weapons. +3 AT vs. mounted. Hook can pull riders from mounts (special maneuver).
weapons.notes: The premier polearm of heavy infantry.

weapons.name: Partisan
weapons.special: Two-handed pole weapon with cross-guards. Better PA than glaive or halberd. Counts as pole weapon for distance classes.
weapons.notes: Large blade with side-prongs for catching weapons.

weapons.name: Flail
weapons.special: Chain weapon — ignores shield PA bonus. All parries against it suffer +2 difficulty. Cannot be parried by daggers. Difficult to control.
weapons.notes: One heavy ball on short chain.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.special: Chain weapon — ignores shield PA bonus. All parries suffer +2 difficulty. On wound: +1 DP from spikes. Cannot be parried by daggers.
weapons.notes: Spiked ball on chain. The heavy version of the flail.

weapons.name: Nunchaku
weapons.special: Chain weapon — ignores shield PA bonus. All parries suffer +2 difficulty. Usable in close quarters.
weapons.notes: Two hardwood sticks connected by short chain or cord.

weapons.name: Unarmed Strike
weapons.special: Deals DP as Endurance damage (A-type). Half also dealt to Life Points. Fist: 1d6(A). Kick: 1d6+1(A) but AT-2. Head butt: 1d6+1(A) but AT-4.
weapons.notes: Brawling talent. Standard unarmed combat.

weapons.name: Wrestling Hold
weapons.special: Wrestling talent. On hit: begins grapple sequence — both fighters make opposing TP rolls each round. Grappled fighter cannot use AT action. Can progress to choke (+1d6 DP per round) or throw (TP as fall damage).
weapons.notes: Uses Wrestling talent. Distinct from Brawling.

weapons.name: Buckler
weapons.special: Small metal shield worn on the fist. +2 PA bonus. Can be used with all one-handed weapons. Counts as a parrying weapon.
weapons.notes: Small boss shield for the fist. Lightweight.

weapons.name: Small Shield
weapons.special: Round or square shield, about half-pace diameter. Standard light shield.
weapons.notes: Common infantry and militia shield.

weapons.name: Battle Shield
weapons.special: Large shield with metal reinforcements. Can make shield bash (1d6+1 DP). Requires ST 15+ to use effectively.
weapons.notes: Round, octagonal, or heraldic form.

weapons.name: Thorwaler Shield
weapons.special: Medium shield. When combined with main weapon for Charge: main weapon +1 DP. When used while mounted: only simple shield bonus.
weapons.notes: Large round wooden shield with iron edges.

weapons.name: Great Shield
weapons.special: Very large shield. Full-body coverage for ranged attacks (+2 RS). Extremely limited AT. Requires ST 17+.
weapons.notes: Cavalry and siege shield. Door-sized.

weapons.name: Leather Shield
weapons.special: Lightweight shield. +1 PA bonus during Defensive Posture. Shield Smash inflicts only 1 DP.
weapons.notes: Round wooden frame covered with multiple layers of tough leather. Common among riding peoples.

weapons.name: Large Leather Shield
weapons.special: Large oval/teardrop leather shield, designed for cavalry use.
weapons.notes: Larger version of the Leather Shield.

weapons.name: Throwing Axe
weapons.special: Can be thrown or used in melee (axes_and_maces talent in melee). Balanced for throwing.
weapons.notes: Light balanced hatchet designed for throwing.

weapons.name: Throwing Knife
weapons.special: Light balanced blade for throwing. Can be used in melee as dagger (improvised, -2 AT).
weapons.notes: Usually carried in sets of 3–5.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.special: Light throwing spear. Can be used in melee as a spear (spears talent). If caught by enemy, it bends and cannot be re-thrown.
weapons.notes: Standard javelin. Also called pilum in some regions.

weapons.name: Bola
weapons.special: On hit: target must succeed a KK/2 check or be entangled (fallen/immobilized for 1d3 rounds). Low damage but strong control effect.
weapons.notes: Weighted balls on cords. Hunting and combat tool.

weapons.name: Short Bow
weapons.special: Can be used from horseback. Wind modifiers apply normally.
weapons.notes: Light recurve bow. Easy to carry and conceal.

weapons.name: Composite Bow
weapons.special: Can be used from horseback. Slightly longer range than short bow.
weapons.notes: Layered construction of wood, horn, and sinew.

weapons.name: Long Bow
weapons.special: Cannot be used from horseback. Requires ST 14+ (else -2 FK). If hit deals > KO/2-2 damage: wound.
weapons.notes: Traditional infantry bow. Requires significant ST and training.

weapons.name: War Bow
weapons.special: Cannot be used from horseback. Requires ST 16+ (else -3 FK). Armor-penetrating: reduce target RS by 1 for damage. If hit deals > KO/2-2: wound.
weapons.notes: Heavy military bow. Short draw time required for reload.

weapons.name: Elf Bow
weapons.special: +2 FK modifier due to exceptional balance. Can be used from horseback at -2 penalty. If hit deals > KO/2-2: wound.
weapons.notes: Elven masterwork bow. Non-elves use at -2 FK and cannot gain the FK bonus.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.special: Reload: 2 actions. If hit deals > KO/2-2: wound. FK modifier applies normally.
weapons.notes: Crank or stirrup-cocked. Standard militia crossbow.

weapons.name: Heavy Crossbow
weapons.special: Reload: 3 actions. Windlass required. If hit deals > KO/2-2: wound. Armor-penetrating: reduce target RS by 2 for damage.
weapons.notes: Windlass-cocked heavy military crossbow.

weapons.name: Hand Crossbow
weapons.special: One-handed. Can be used from horseback. Reload: 2 actions. If hit deals > KO/2-2: wound.
weapons.notes: Compact crossbow for concealed carry. Source: AK p. 7.

weapons.name: War Scythe
weapons.special: Two-handed. Can hook and unseat mounted opponents. Difficult to use in tight formations. Attacks from this weapon cannot be parried by daggers.
weapons.notes: Peasant weapon converted for war. Blade mounted upright on long haft.

weapons.name: Naginata
weapons.special: Two-handed. Curved blade on long haft. Better PA than glaive. Used in some eastern Aventuria martial arts.
weapons.notes: Exotic polearm from Thalusian traditions.

weapons.name: Katar
weapons.special: Punching dagger. Gripped across palm; the blade extends forward from the fist. +1 AT due to unusual attack angle.
weapons.notes: Common in Novadis and Tulamide regions.

weapons.name: Khopesh
weapons.special: Sickle-shaped blade. The hook can catch and disarm: on critical AT, opponent must pass ST check or be disarmed.
weapons.notes: Ancient weapon of Khom desert region.

weapons.name: Langsax
weapons.special: Long single-edged blade, between a long knife and short sword. Can use either Sabers or Swords talent (use whichever is higher).
weapons.notes: Traditional Northlander blade.

weapons.name: Sai
weapons.special: Metal prong weapon with side tines for catching blades. Excellent PA. Can trap opponent's weapon on successful PA (STR contest to disarm).
weapons.notes: Used in pairs. Primarily a defensive weapon.

weapons.name: Scimitar
weapons.special: Broadly curved heavy saber. High AT modifier. Common cavalry weapon.
weapons.notes: Broader and heavier curve than shamshir.

weapons.name: Lasso
weapons.special: Does no damage. On hit: target is entangled (falls prone, can act but at -2 AT/PA until freed). Target must pass STR check vs. thrower's AT roll to free self each round.
weapons.notes: Rope with weighted loop. Cowboy/Novadis tool.

weapons.name: Whip
weapons.special: Attack only — cannot parry. High AT modifier, very long reach. On hit can cause pain/distraction in addition to damage. Ignores shield PA bonus.
weapons.notes: Leather or braided cord. Usually attack-only weapon.

weapons.name: Scourge
weapons.special: Multi-thong flail. Attack only — cannot parry. Ignores shield PA bonus. All parries suffer +2 difficulty.
weapons.notes: Multiple leather straps with knotted ends.

weapons.name: Hook Sword
weapons.special: Blade with hooked tip for catching and disarming. On successful PA: may attempt disarm (STR contest). Can be linked in pairs for extended reach. From AK.
weapons.notes: Exotic blade. Usable with swords or fencing weapons (use whichever is higher).

weapons.name: Kama
weapons.special: Short sickle-like blade. Can be used with axes_and_maces or chain_weapons. When chained (kusarigama): use chain_weapons talent, gains chain properties.
weapons.notes: Farming tool adapted as weapon.

weapons.name: Main Gauche
weapons.special: Left-hand parrying dagger. Counts as parrying weapon. Superior PA to standard parrying dagger. Side-bars catch opponent blades.
weapons.notes: Designed for fencing style: rapier in right hand, main gauche in left.

weapons.name: Lance
weapons.special: Couched lance charge: uses Jousting talent (AT only, cannot parry). When used on foot as spear: uses Spears talent at -2 AT. Charge damage multiplied by mount speed factor.
weapons.notes: Both tournament and war lances use Jousting talent when mounted.
